modelNamePrefix.description:
If set, all created models will be named with this prefix and a random set of characters appended.

Ex: `<Prefix>_u12i34`

If only one model is created, the model will be named `<Prefix>`.

If this prefix is not set, the model will be prefixed with its template name, resulting in
`<Template Name>_u12i34`.
